series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_style_standard: Adult cinematic physically realistic 3D historical reconstruction & live-action 65mm location cinematography (ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo primes, Kodak Vision3 500T grade: warm sandstone highlights, deep cerulean Summer Sea, lush emerald pastures, muted volcanic stone)
visual_qc_note: All ten frames passed visual review, are 1376x768 sRGB PNGs, are uploaded to Drive folder 1C-0rzizehths1tSA0As1NXfVJRW81y0G, and each Drive MD5 matches its local file; Drive lists exactly ten images. Six passed on the first pass (IMG0252, IMG0253, IMG0257, IMG0258, IMG0259, IMG0260). Four were rerendered: IMG0251 and IMG0256 had given the elder shepherd pale steel-blue irises (and IMG0256 had drifted into a heroic poster stance and a valley with white farm buildings and patchwork fields), so both were re-blocked to show the men in profile or from behind with no iris colour exposed; IMG0254's iris study had drifted to a stubbled adult male with a lens-like iris and was reframed to a clean-shaven young face with a natural amethyst gradient; IMG0255 had been a posed cast procession with a likeness of a known screen actress and was re-blocked to scattered anonymous figures mostly turned away. Continuity flag carried forward: the braided wool headband on the woman in IMG0258 must not appear again.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle vertical scale — two herdsmen dwarfed by a columnar basalt cliff
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved rerender: low-angle rear three-quarter view below the columnar basalt cliff, both men seen in profile from behind so no iris colour is exposed — the pale hair and skin read as the brightest elements against black rock. No eye-colour exposure means no risk of the steel-blue failure.

scenes.visual_beat: Macro material study — hand-spun wool glowing like filament silver-gold
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved: hands only, calloused with rawhide wrist wraps, hank catching hard low sun; fibre reads as pale silver-gold shading to platinum white. Interior is a croft-like room, acceptable as a roundhouse interior; its thatch must not be read as the exterior roof type.

scenes.visual_beat: Intimate close-up — platinum-white coiled hair, seventy-year-old clan woman
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved: pure bone-white hair with no grey or dye, deeply lined alabaster skin weathered ruddy, unmistakable violet iris crescent under a heavy lid, wholly unglamorous and unposed.

scenes.visual_beat: Extreme close-up iris study — lilac, pale indigo and amethyst
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved rerender: reframed from an isolated eyeball to a tight portrait from brow to upper lip, clean-shaven young face with both temple braids visible; amethyst-violet irises with a natural lilac-to-indigo gradient and a soft sky catchlight, human rather than lens-like. No beard, no brow drift.

scenes.visual_beat: Transitional wide at dusk — scattered clan along the crest, three cones and the sea
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved rerender: clansfolk scattered in twos and threes across the dark crest, mostly turned away and mid-task, no procession and no face resembling a known performer. Distant figures are tiny and anonymous; three cones and a pale sea line behind.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental framing — elder and young herdsman on a basalt shelf
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved rerender: both men in profile facing out over a wild valley, eyes narrowed to thin shadowed slits against low sun, so the colour is implied rather than exposed. The earlier valley (white farm buildings, patchwork fields) is replaced by unbroken open pasture and a braided river with no structures.

scenes.visual_beat: Over-the-shoulder — the young herdsman turning to answer, eyes narrowed to the light
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved: elder's silver hair and sheepskin soft in the near foreground, young face sharp with unmistakable violet eyes, temple braids lifted by wind, wattle fold behind.

scenes.visual_beat: Deep-focus wide — homestead ring, hurdle carried between the roundhouses
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved: nine conical dark slate roofs on circular dry-stone basalt walls, children running ahead, wool beating at the left edge, cone smoking above. Continuity flag: the woman at the left edge wears a braided wool headband — that accessory must stay out of later frames.

scenes.visual_beat: Ultra-wide establishing vista — the whole homestead in its green fold
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved: nine or ten round stone roofs in open wild pasture with no boundaries, tracks or walls in lines, three smoking cones and the Summer Sea at far right; a crook leans on the near roundhouse wall.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium close-up — young herdsman at the fold gate, mid-thought, unimpressed
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved: a working man interrupted rather than a posed hero, sharp chiselled features, two thin temple braids, saturated violet irises confirmed by eye crop, flock and cone behind.
